cases.request: Review our partial ADK deployment for our existing shared GKE cluster. We deliberately use Python 3.11 and ADK 2.7.0. Preserve our Helm-style naming, existing service account, application readiness path and dependency versions. Suggest the smallest changes needed before we deploy; do not create a new cluster or run cloud commands.

files.deploy/workload.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: payments-agent
  namespace: shared-apps
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: payments-agent}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: payments-agent}
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: payments-runtime
      containers:
      - name: agent
        image: example.invalid/team/payments:stable
        ports: [{containerPort: 8080}]
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet: {path: /ready, port: 8080}
files.ARCHITECTURE.md: The cluster, shared-apps namespace and payments-runtime KSA are pre-existing resources owned by the platform team. This prototype has not yet connected its ADK agent to app.py. Preserve /ready for platform monitoring.
